tldr.text: Consistent with such a role we show that DDX39B controls the expression of many MS susceptibility genes and important immune-related genes.
Splicing of FOXP3 introns, which belong to a previously unrecognized type of introns with C-rich polypyrimidine tracts, was exquisitely sensitive to DDX39B levels.

problem.text: Consistent with such a role we show that DDX39B controls the expression of many MS susceptibility genes and important immune-related genes.
Given the importance of FOXP3 in autoimmunity, this work cements DDX39B as an important guardian of immune tolerance.
